recognize_zh: 這是母細胞 gate 的 CD7 對 CD34 流式散點圖（dot plot）：大部分母細胞 CD34 陰性到弱陽性，只有一小群 CD34 強陽性；CD7 從弱到中度部分表現，沒有形成明確的 T 細胞族群。
features: Dot plot gated on blasts: CD7-APC700 (x) versus CD34-PC7 (y), log scales
Majority of blasts CD34 negative to dim (<10^3)
Minor subset CD34 bright (~10^4), predominantly CD7 negative
CD7 shows a continuous smear from negative to ~10^4 (partial dim-to-moderate expression)
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of the blast gate displays CD7 versus CD34. The blasts are largely CD34 negative to dim with a minor CD34-bright subset, and show heterogeneous partial dim-to-moderate CD7 expression. CD7 is a nonspecific marker frequently aberrant in myeloid and mixed phenotype blasts and does not assign T lineage; cytoplasmic CD3 is required for that. Findings are compatible with an immature population with heterogeneous CD34 expression, as seen in the reported mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid.

ddx.vs: T lineage requires bright cytoplasmic CD3 (at the level of mature T cells), not CD7 expression alone.
ETP-ALL is cCD3 positive with CD7 typically bright, CD1a/CD8 negative and CD5 dim, plus stem/myeloid markers, whereas this population lacks bright CD7.
Separation from B/myeloid MPAL depends on B-lineage markers (strong CD19 with CD79a, CD22 or CD10), not on the CD7/CD34 pattern.
